# Files sidebar section

<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: reference -->

Look up what the Files sidebar section shows and what its controls do.

## Folder tree contents and rows
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

The folder tree lists files tracked by Git, new files, and empty folders created in Heidrun during the current session. Folders appear before files, and each group is sorted alphabetically. Empty folders disappear from the tree after Heidrun restarts because Git does not list empty folders.

Folders ignored by Git appear only when the option to show ignored files is enabled; an ignored folder cannot be unfolded. The rows show, from left to right, indentation guides or spacing, a folder arrow when available, an icon, and the name. Changed files show a colored status letter at the right of the row, and a folder containing changed files shows a dot; file and folder icons are grey.

## Header buttons
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Button | Action |
| --- | --- |
| **New file** | Starts creating an empty file in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **New folder** | Starts creating an empty folder in the selected folder, the folder of the selected file, or the repository root. |
| **Refresh** | Reads the folder tree again. |
| **Collapse all folders** | Folds every folder. |
| **More options** | Opens the choices for indentation, row height, and indent guides. |

## More options
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

| Choice | Options |
| --- | --- |
| **Indentation** | **Small**, **Medium**, or **Large** |
| **Row height** | **Compact** or **Comfortable** |
| **Indent guides** | **Show** or **Hide** |

A check mark in the menu shows the active choice.

## Selection and open folders
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/files.ts -->

Only one row can be selected at a time. Each workspace remembers its selected row, and Heidrun unfolds the folders above that row when the workspace is selected again. The selection remains when you switch to another sidebar section or close the large Git window; clicking empty space in the Files sidebar section clears the selection for the selected workspace.

Folder open and folded states remain when you switch sidebar sections. When you change to a workspace with a different repository, the folder tree resets and the folders above that workspace's selected row unfold.

## File context menu
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/filesPanel.json -->

Right-click a file row to open its context menu. The menu has these choices:

| Choice | Action |
| --- | --- |
| **Copy absolute path** | Copies the file's full path. |
| **Copy relative path** | Copies the file's path relative to the selected workspace. |

After a copy, Heidrun shows the copied path in a message. Folder rows do not have a context menu.
